# Lambda Powertools Reference

> Production-grade AWS CDK reference architecture for Lambda + Powertools
> serverless applications: five-stack CDK composition (data / WAF / backend /
> frontend / audit) behind a cdk.Stage, five-rule-pack cdk-nag gating on every synth,
> end-to-end customer-managed-key encryption, WAF + CloudFront, CloudTrail
> object-level data events, browser RUM with X-Ray correlation, Athena
> access-log analytics, and supply-chain hygiene (pinned everything, grouped
> Dependabot with cooldowns, pip-audit, CodeQL, Scorecard).

Key facts for agents working in this repo:

- Two Python venvs exist because CDK and Powertools require incompatible
  `attrs` versions: `.venv` (CDK side) and `.venv-lambda` (runtime side).
  Never mix them. `make install` provisions both plus node tooling.
- `cdk synth`/`deploy`/`destroy` MUST use the `'**'` glob — the stacks are
  nested in a cdk.Stage and bare invocations silently do nothing.
- The CDK CLI is pinned in package.json and invoked via `npx cdk`.
- `docs/openapi.json` is committed and CI-gated; regenerate with `make openapi`
  after touching routes or models.
- `make pr` runs every CI gate locally. `make help` lists all targets.
- Deployment environments: default `prod` keeps legacy stack names;
  `make deploy ENV=<name>` creates a namespaced ephemeral copy. `dev` is
  pipeline-reserved — never `make deploy ENV=dev`.
- Pipeline mode: `-c pipeline=true` synthesizes a self-mutating CDK Pipeline
  (`PipelineStack`, CodeConnections-sourced from GitHub `main`: dev →
  integration tests → PromoteToProd approval → prod) instead of the
  directly-deployable Stage; `make deploy-pipeline` is the one-time birth deploy.
- The `cdk-scaffold-boundary` permissions boundary is mandatory for every
  deploy: run `make bootstrap-boundary`, then
  `cdk bootstrap --custom-permissions-boundary cdk-scaffold-boundary`.
- The API is same-origin: CloudFront `/api/*` proxies to a REGIONAL API
  Gateway, and a regional WAF rule rejects any request lacking the
  CloudFront-injected `x-origin-verify` secret header (fail-closed 403).
- Any region in appconfig_extension.py's pinned AppConfig extension layer map (all
  regions AWS publishes the arm64 extension to) synthesizes; for an unmapped
  region pass `-c appconfig_extension_layer_arn=<arn>` (or the
  `APPCONFIG_EXTENSION_LAYER_ARN` env var) — otherwise synth fails loudly.

## Source

- [lambda/app.py](lambda/app.py): the Lambda handler — Powertools logger,
  tracer, metrics, idempotency, feature flags, validated env vars, OpenAPI
- [lambda/extension_store.py](lambda/extension_store.py): feature-flag store
  reading the AppConfig Lambda extension's local endpoint
- [infrastructure/backend_app.py](infrastructure/backend_app.py): the main
  application construct (KMS, SSM, AppConfig, Lambda, API Gateway, regional
  WAF + origin-verify lockdown, canary deployment, monitoring + alarms);
  consumes the idempotency table from the data stack
- [infrastructure/data_stack.py](infrastructure/data_stack.py): DataStack —
  the DynamoDB idempotency table + its dedicated CMK, `retain_data`-gated
- [infrastructure/audit_stack.py](infrastructure/audit_stack.py): AuditStack —
  CloudTrail data-event trail + its log bucket + dedicated CMK
- [infrastructure/pipeline_stack.py](infrastructure/pipeline_stack.py): the
  self-mutating CD pipeline, synthesized only with `-c pipeline=true`
- [infrastructure/bootstrap/cdk-scaffold-boundary.json](infrastructure/bootstrap/cdk-scaffold-boundary.json):
  the mandatory permissions-boundary policy (`make bootstrap-boundary`)
- [infrastructure/app_stage.py](infrastructure/app_stage.py): the
  Stage grouping all five stacks; environment naming lives here
- [infrastructure/nag_utils.py](infrastructure/nag_utils.py): cdk-nag v3
  policy-validation-plugin wiring (`attach_nag_packs`), the `acknowledge_rules`
  acknowledgment adapter, and shared helpers (confused-deputy-guarded KMS
  service grants, log buckets, log groups)
- [infrastructure/validation_aspects.py](infrastructure/validation_aspects.py):
  project-convention Aspect (explicit log retention + removal policies)
- [scripts/audit_account.sh](scripts/audit_account.sh): read-only post-teardown
  account audit (`make audit-account`)
- [scripts/dns_lifecycle.sh](scripts/dns_lifecycle.sh): hosted-zone
  hibernate/wake lifecycle (`make hibernate-dns` / `make wake-dns`)
- [tests/](tests/): unit (100% coverage gate), CDK assertions + in-process
  cdk-nag gate, live integration tests
